title: Public, source-grounded benchmark boundary
outcomes: Evaluations remain traceable, reproducible, public-safe, and explicit about uncertainty.

decision_rights: supply decision context and reject unsuitable synthesis

constraints: Canonical workflow state stays in repo-local .go JSON and JSONL.
Expert claims require public-source provenance or explicit inference/abstention labels.
Generated evaluations, caches, downloaded pages, and private context remain outside Git by default.
The project must not imply affiliation with or endorsement by council members.

quality_attributes.scenario: A lens includes an expert position or quotation.
quality_attributes.measure: Unsupported or unlabeled claims accepted by validation

quality_attributes.scenario: A historical evaluation is reopened after benchmark updates.
quality_attributes.measure: Missing immutable benchmark or lens reference

quality_attributes.scenario: Repository content is prepared for publication.
quality_attributes.measure: Tracked secrets, private records, or copied source corpora

risks: Public evidence may be incomplete, outdated, or ambiguous.
Weighting can create false precision unless rationale and dispersion remain visible.
A council synthesis may be mistaken for endorsement without prominent non-affiliation language.
